### 🐛 Problem Description
A clear and concise description of the bug.

---

### 🔄 Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to `https://myty.world` (or `https://qa.myty.world`)
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See error

---

### 🎯 Expected vs. Actual Behavior
- **Expected:** What should have happened.
- **Actual:** What actually happened.

---

### 💻 Environment
- **Environment:** Production (`myty.world`) / QA (`qa.myty.world`)
- **Browser:** Chrome / Safari / Firefox / Edge

### ✅ Acceptance Criteria for Fix
- [ ] Bug is resolved and no longer reproducible.

- [ ] Deployed to and verified on QA before production promotion.
